messages:
Maya Chen: kicking off the dedicated-prod deploy in ~10 mins. Change is runtime kernel patch + model v2.3. Rolling strategy 20% -> 50% -> 100%. I'll follow smoke checks. @Infra Oncall can you watch p95 latency and error_rate?
Samir Patel: I'll be on the deploy. ETA start 12:10 PT. Runbook: https://go/release/runbooks/dedicated-prod. Quick checks: health endpoint, canary logs, and evals.
deploy-bot: deploy started by Samir (deploy/realms/dedicated-prod) at 12:11 PT. build=2026.3.4; changes=[runtime/kernel-opt, model:v2.3]
Olivia Nguyen: watching evals + throughput dashboard. Will run regression prompts and call out any quality regressions.
Dmitri Volkov: canary healthcheck ran, result = OK. sample: ```curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://prod-api.redwood.ai/health
200 0.213``` Had a single 502 earlier but that was pre-canary.
Maya Chen: plan: 10m canary, then 50% for 5m, then full. Rollback thresholds: p95 > 350ms OR error_rate > 0.8%. If breached -> immediate rollback. Samir — confirm rollback command and that you have sudo.
Samir Patel: rollback command = `deploy rollback --to revision 2026.3.3 --env prod`. I have sudo. Feature flags are wired to fallback variants as well.
Infra Oncall: baseline p95=~180ms. I'll set a temporary alert at 300ms and keep watch on node CPU. Muting noisy charts now. Autorestart policy is enabled for runtime pods.
Olivia Nguyen: starting smoke prompt set A (50 queries) against canary now. Will paste any odd outputs. So far looks clean.
Samir Patel: canary reached 10% — no error alerts. proceeding to 50%.
deploy-bot: promotion: canary -> 50% at 12:17 PT. No active alerts.
Maya Chen: quick check — logs show a short spike in model queue length at 12:18. Samir can you tail the runtime logs?
Samir Patel: tailing now:
```
kubectl logs -n runtime --selector=app=runtime -f | grep "kvcache" | tail -n 20
[12:18:02] kvcache: eviction=0.03 miss=0.01
[12:18:14] kvcache: eviction=0.12 miss=0.07
```
Seems like a brief GC bump, not blocking. continuing to watch.
Olivia Nguyen: evals passing. Example prompt: "Summarize product intent for X" -> concise, relevant. No hallucination spikes.
Maya Chen: moving to 100% if no objections. Samir, trigger final promotion?
Samir Patel: promoted to 100% at 12:22 PT.
deploy-bot: deploy finished successfully at 12:22 PT. traffic = 100% -> build=2026.3.4
Infra Oncall: monitoring p95, error_rate, cpu. Current p95=195ms, error_rate=0.12%. No rollback needed.
Dmitri Volkov: spotted one trace for a long prompt with 430ms tail latency. Filed INF-4521 and attached trace. tagging @Olivia for regression check.
Olivia Nguyen: ack. I'll add the prompt to the regression harness and re-run 200-sample tests.
Maya Chen: thanks team — leaving a postdeploy note in the release doc. If anything pops in next 30m, ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
